verdict: 4 failures on local Chrome: two look like test bugs (a stale price and an impossible sold-out count), two point to the local server at localhost:3100 struggling (a goto timeout and 503s); no clear product defect.

failures.test: Product info › shows the product name and price
failures.summary: The test hardcodes £24.90 but the page shows £24.99, which matches the site's other .99 prices; probably a typo or stale price in the test.
failures.evidence: Locator getByText('£24.90', { exact: true }) not found; snapshot: heading "Twill Overshirt" followed by paragraph: £24.99
failures.next_step: Check the intended price for products[0] with the content owner. If £24.99 is correct, update line 10 of product-info.spec.ts, or read the price from profile data.

failures.test: Product info › sizes that are out of stock for the colour are disabled
failures.summary: For Mustard the page correctly disables S and XL, but the test expects 3 sold-out sizes while also asserting M and L are enabled, which is impossible with 4 sizes.
failures.evidence: Expected: 3, Received: 2; snapshot: radio "S (out of stock)" [disabled], radio "M" [checked], radio "L", radio "XL (out of stock)" [disabled]
failures.next_step: Change toHaveCount(3) to toHaveCount(2) on line 30 of product-info.spec.ts, or derive the expected count from profile test data.

failures.test: Product extras › the size chart switches between inches and centimetres
failures.summary: The page never reached the load event on the local server; this failed in beforeEach, before any test logic ran.
failures.evidence: TimeoutError: page.goto: Timeout 30000ms exceeded. navigating to "http://localhost:3100/"; page still about:blank, title "Loading http://localhost:3100/"
failures.next_step: Check the localhost:3100 server logs from this run for hangs or 503s (another test saw 503s). Make sure the server is fully warmed before tests start, then rerun.

failures.test: Product info › selecting a colour updates the stock for the selected size
failures.summary: Mustard is checked, but the size stayed on S at '12 In Stock' with no out-of-stock labels while the page logged repeated 503s. The variant data likely failed to load from the local server.
failures.evidence: consoleErrors: 10× "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 503 (Service Unavailable)"; snapshot: radio "Mustard" [checked], radio "S" [checked], paragraph: 12 In Stock, definition: Calculating delivery date
failures.next_step: Find which requests returned 503 (network log or server logs) and fix the local backend. Rerun; the same click worked in the 'sizes out of stock' test, so expect this to pass once the backend is healthy.
